text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d the a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d l-o-g-g-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t-s that p-r-o-b-e-d the c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and l-e-f-t a s-c-r-i-p-t d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y o-n d-i-s-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-i-s-k-r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the actor a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to t-a-k-e o-v-e-r the a-f-f-e-c-t-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s v-i-a a p-h-i-s-h e-v-e-n-t s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e and l-e-f-t a s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n d-u-m-p in the n-e-t-w-o-r-k l-o-g-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s-v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
3) the actor c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d the g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s in-t-o c-a-s-h o-u-t-f-l-o-w-s and l-e-f-t a t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y r-e-p-o-r-t in the m-e-r-c-h-a-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d-m-o-n-i-t-o-r-c-h-e-c-k
4) the actor c-o-n-c-e-a-l-e-d the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y b-y i-m-i-t-a-t-i-n-g n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s and l-e-f-t a n-e-t-w-o-r-k b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r d-i-a-r-y on the h-o-s-t m-a-c-h-i-n-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-o-m-a-l-y-r-e-v-i-e-w
5) the actor r-e-m-o-v-e-d the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e-b-y d-e-l-e-t-i-n-g k-e-y l-o-g d-a-t-a and l-e-f-t a p-a-r-t-i-a-l r-e-m-n-a-n-d e-x-t-r-a-c-t in the s-y-s-t-e-m b-a-c-k-u-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-a-t-a-i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y-c-h-e-c-k
